Girls Rock Monthly Ride

Santa Cruz, CA · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

Girls Rock Monthly Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Santa Cruz, CA. It rolls monthly, on a Sunday at 10:00 am from Varies (Santa Cruz Mountain Brewing for Sep–Oct 2026). Pace: groups by skill level, guided.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: groups by skill level, guided. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @girlsrockmtb the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Girls Rock Monthly Ride group ride

A free monthly women's mountain bike ride on Santa Cruz trails. Riders check in, split into groups by level with volunteer guides, and roll out at 10 am. First-timers are welcome. Register online before you come; the start venue changes month to month.
